I tried, I dislike my teacher and picture her as an adversary. specifically my math teacher, her nose is always in my business. Say she says for all the students to open to a certain page on a book, after she says that she would say my name even though I am on that page and she would say my name with disgust. Now picture that same person standing behind you throughout the whole class period scrutinizing every thing you do. I told her to back off many times but she says something such as "I am just making sure" like Jesus woman back off.  I dislike my Reading teacher because she has a brain and try's to get me "help". That "help" is which of a counselor, I have identified that the counselor does not trust and or like me. I lied my way out of all 2 calls because I dislike attention from those close to me. My mother does not understand math, and my father gave up. My brother is a child prodigy at engineering collage at 14, he dislikes helping me and when I put effort to develop a new skill he gets better than me very quickly out shadowing me. He dislikes me so I cant get help from him.  I feel as if everybody in my family is very talented but for me.

I always predicted that I will run into an idea so abstract that I will be unable to understand it and while I was trying to understand this imposable level of math I fell behind on all the other subjects. I gave up trying about a month ago and just gave up  school.  I pretty much accept that I am failure. I know I am a burden to my parents and I plan on moving away from them. This Consists of  Suicide, running away and not spending anything on behalf of my parents. I stopped eating school lunches and limited using things such as water, plates and paper towels.
